notes.title: OCEAN CITY RACING: Redux Is Now Available!
notes.content:
The popular open world driving game features multiple game modes and offers total freedom to it's players!


    FREE ROAM MODE: Explore Ocean City in it’s full detail by allowing you to exit vehicles and walk around on foot.
     RACE MODE: Drive your way through the thrilling events and unlock new vehicles as you progress.
    TIME-TRIAL MODE: Beat the clock while driving at exciting tracks that also includes off-road and in-door environments.
 
https://media.giphy.com/media/3oz8xXO2GzM4qxwrQI/giphy.gif

 => Get It Now for $2.99 on STEAM <=

OCEAN CITY RACING has been updated with improved graphics and environment quality, a brand new map area, new mini games and with the ability to control a new type of “vehicle”.


OCEAN CITY RACING: Redux Feature List

•	Brand New Map Area in Free Roam Mode to Explore
•	Improved Vehicle Handling
•	Drifting is now easier to kick off
•	New Mini Games Including Car Football and Car Skating
•	New Stunt Locations
•	New “Controllable” Vehicle Type: Bear
•	Improved Graphics Quality and Post Process Effects
•	Improved Environment Quality
•	Improved Pedestrian Animation Quality
•	Destructible Traffic Lights and Street Lights in Free Roam Mode
•	Improved Draw Distance
•	Improved Traffic Density
•	Improved Overall Texture Quality
•	Reduced Music Sound and Addition of Dynamic Sound System
•	Improved In Game UI Messages
•	Improved Overall Optimisation

https://media.giphy.com/media/l0HlO1cP91zI0ErW8/giphy.gif

notes.title: Open World Exploration , Thrilling Races , Unique Time Trial Events - Update Plans of OCEAN CITY RACING
notes.content:
=> Get It Now for $2.99 on STEAM  Get it now for $2.99 on STEAM <=

http://i.imgur.com/Ma2VD2q.gif

 Watch STEAM Launch Trailer OCR 

What Will 2015 Bring to Ocean City Racing? 
First off all i would like to thank everyone who purchased , played and gave feedback on OCEAN CITY RACING. I have received many great ideas , thoughts about the game that worked very hard to create. While i would love to implement all these great ideas , my hands are tied as i am the only person who is involved with the project from day one.

My current goal is to bring OCEAN CITY RACING to more gamers. To accomplish this , a Mac OS X version is being planned to be released on 2015 to Mac users who are looking for an old-school new generation open world driving experience!

http://oceancitygame.com/gifocr.gif
